prop:hic-2022-hatch-strg-profile.title: Honda Information Center profile header, 2022 Civic Hatchback Sport Touring (STRG), Rallye Red
prop:hic-2022-hatch-strg-profile.publisher: American Honda Motor Co. (Honda Information Center)
prop:hic-2022-hatch-strg-profile.applicability: 2022 US Civic Hatchback Sport Touring (18-in machined/black wheels); same body as 2024 (all published exterior dimensions identical 2022-2024)
prop:hic-2022-hatch-strg-profile.notes: Shown on https://www.hondainfocenter.com/2024/Civic-Hatchback/ (2024 Civic Hatchback page reuses the 2022 image). Studio render, near-orthographic side view. Local copy only in cache/photos (git-ignored).

proportions.overhang_front.description: Front overhang: front axle to foremost body point (side view)

candidates.evidence: Image feature located by algorithm: silhouette min column minus fitted front wheel centre

applicability.notes: Exterior body identical 2022-2024 per Honda spec tables (length, width, height, wheelbase, track unchanged)

candidates.how_to_measure: Plumb bob from the front bumper's foremost point and from the front hub centre; measure the floor distance (+-5 mm).

derivation.algorithm: silhouette min column minus fitted front wheel centre

proportions.overhang_rear.description: Rear overhang: rear axle to rearmost body point (side view)

candidates.evidence: Image feature located by algorithm: silhouette max column minus fitted rear wheel centre

applicability.notes: Exterior body identical 2022-2024 per Honda spec tables (length, width, height, wheelbase, track unchanged)

candidates.how_to_measure: Plumb bob from the rear bumper's rearmost point and from the rear hub centre; measure the floor distance (+-5 mm).

derivation.algorithm: silhouette max column minus fitted rear wheel centre

candidates.evidence: Image feature located by algorithm: ratio of silhouette-derived overhang pixel lengths; independent of scale

applicability.notes: Exterior body identical 2022-2024 per Honda spec tables (length, width, height, wheelbase, track unchanged)

candidates.how_to_measure: As for the overhangs.
candidates.notes: Used by scripts/derivations/dimensions.py with the published length and wheelbase. 1-sigma 0.003749 1; range = +-2 sigma (localisation + scale + perspective).

derivation.algorithm: ratio of silhouette-derived overhang pixel lengths; independent of scale

proportions.roof_peak_y.description: Longitudinal position of roof peak (centre of the columns at the minimum row)

candidates.evidence: Image feature located by algorithm: centre of the flat run at the minimum top-profile row; range covers the run

applicability.notes: Exterior body identical 2022-2024 per Honda spec tables (length, width, height, wheelbase, track unchanged)

candidates.how_to_measure: Level laid on the roof: find the highest point, plumb down, measure from front hub centre.

derivation.algorithm: centre of the flat run at the minimum top-profile row; range covers the run

proportions.windshield_base_y.description: Windshield base / cowl (silhouette slope break hood -> glass): Y

candidates.evidence: Image feature located by algorithm: first breakpoint of a continuous 3-segment line fit to the top profile, front axle -> roof peak

applicability.notes: Exterior body identical 2022-2024 per Honda spec tables (length, width, height, wheelbase, track unchanged)

candidates.how_to_measure: Measure from front hub centre to the windshield base at the centreline (tape along the hood + plumb), +-10 mm.
candidates.notes: Silhouette break: the true glass base can sit slightly behind the visible hood/cowl edge. Localisation sigma 2 px. 1-sigma 0.01782 m; range = +-2 sigma (localisation + scale + perspective).

derivation.algorithm: first breakpoint of a continuous 3-segment line fit to the top profile, front axle -> roof peak

proportions.windshield_base_z.description: Windshield base / cowl height above ground

candidates.evidence: Image feature located by algorithm: top profile at the first breakpoint

applicability.notes: Exterior body identical 2022-2024 per Honda spec tables (length, width, height, wheelbase, track unchanged)

candidates.how_to_measure: Tape from floor to the windshield base at the centreline (+-5 mm).

derivation.algorithm: top profile at the first breakpoint

proportions.windshield_header_y.description: Windshield top / roof header (second slope break): Y

candidates.evidence: Image feature located by algorithm: second breakpoint of the same fit

applicability.notes: Exterior body identical 2022-2024 per Honda spec tables (length, width, height, wheelbase, track unchanged)

candidates.how_to_measure: Measure from front hub centre to the top edge of the windshield glass (plumb), +-10 mm.

derivation.algorithm: second breakpoint of the same fit

candidates.evidence: Image feature located by algorithm: atan of the middle-segment slope (scale-anisotropy corrected)

applicability.notes: Exterior body identical 2022-2024 per Honda spec tables (length, width, height, wheelbase, track unchanged)

candidates.how_to_measure: Inclinometer on the glass at the centreline.
candidates.notes: Silhouette (outer glass) line, not the glass at centreline; 2 deg sigma. 1-sigma 0.03491 rad; range = +-2 sigma (localisation + scale + perspective).

derivation.algorithm: atan of the middle-segment slope (scale-anisotropy corrected)

proportions.hatch_angle.description: Rear hatch glass silhouette angle from horizontal

candidates.evidence: Image feature located by algorithm: continuous 3-segment line fit to the top profile, roof peak -> rear extreme; steepest of the first two segments

applicability.notes: Exterior body identical 2022-2024 per Honda spec tables (length, width, height, wheelbase, track unchanged)

candidates.how_to_measure: Inclinometer on the hatch glass at the centreline.
candidates.notes: Includes the effect of the roof spoiler on the silhouette; 2.5 deg sigma. 1-sigma 0.04363 rad; range = +-2 sigma (localisation + scale + perspective).

proportions.sill_z_mid_wheelbase.description: Side sill (rocker) lower edge height at mid-wheelbase

candidates.evidence: Image feature located by algorithm: lowest opaque row (median over 21 columns) at mid-wheelbase

applicability.notes: Exterior body identical 2022-2024 per Honda spec tables (length, width, height, wheelbase, track unchanged)

candidates.how_to_measure: Tape from floor to the sill lower edge at mid-wheelbase, both sides (+-3 mm).
candidates.notes: Not the same quantity as the published minimum ground clearance (134 mm, no-load). 1-sigma 0.007933 m; range = +-2 sigma (localisation + scale + perspective).

derivation.algorithm: lowest opaque row (median over 21 columns) at mid-wheelbase

proportions.wheel_center_z_front.description: Front wheel centre height above ground (photo)

candidates.evidence: Image feature located by algorithm: least-squares circle fit to tyre edge

applicability.notes: Exterior body identical 2022-2024 per Honda spec tables (length, width, height, wheelbase, track unchanged)

candidates.how_to_measure: Tape from floor to hub centre (+-2 mm).
candidates.notes: In a render the tyre is undeflected; a real loaded tyre sits ~10-20 mm lower. Equals the unloaded tyre radius here. 1-sigma 0.009896 m; range = +-2 sigma (localisation + scale + perspective).

derivation.algorithm: least-squares circle fit to tyre edge

candidates.how_to_measure: Tape from hub centre to the arch lip directly above it, car at curb weight (+-2 mm). Primary ride-height reference.

derivation.algorithm: first run of >=3 body-coloured px (Lab distance < 30 to door-box median) scanning up from tyre top

proportions.rim_to_tyre_ratio_front.description: front visible rim diameter / tyre diameter (photo)

candidates.evidence: Image feature located by algorithm: concentric HoughCircles

applicability.notes: Exterior body identical 2022-2024 per Honda spec tables (length, width, height, wheelbase, track unchanged)

candidates.how_to_measure: Measure rim flange and tyre diameters.
candidates.notes: Nominal 18 in / 645.2 mm = 0.709; visible rim lip is slightly smaller than the bead seat diameter. 1-sigma 0.02591 1; range = +-2 sigma (localisation + scale + perspective).

derivation.algorithm: concentric HoughCircles

candidates.how_to_measure: Long-lens (>=200 mm equiv.) straight-on front photo from >=15 m with a tape on the ground, or tape the mirror glass centre position from the front hub centre and floor directly.
candidates.notes: Needs a straight-on front-view image or direct measurement.
searches: Only one straight-on manufacturer view found (the 620x200 side render above); hondanews.com/hondanews.ca 2022 galleries contain only 3/4 and action shots; automobiles.honda.com configurator is 403 (blocked); no straight-on front/rear press view located
The mirror in the side render overlaps the A-pillar/glass and has no algorithmically separable outline at 9 mm/px
